Faq.title: Everything you need to know about Lingoberg.
Faq.subtitle: Have another question? Reach our team anytime at contact@lingoberg.com.

q1.question: Which German exams and levels are supported?
q1.answer: Lingoberg provides full exam preparation for CEFR A1 (Start Deutsch 1 / telc Deutsch A1) and CEFR B1 (Zertifikat Deutsch / telc Deutsch B1) across all 5 official sections: Hören (Listening), Sprechen (Speaking), Lesen (Reading), Schreiben (Writing), and B1 Sprachbausteine (Grammar & Vocabulary in Context), plus A1–C1 German audio stories.

q2.question: What is free to try, and how do Exam Credits work?
q2.answer: Teil 1 of Exam 01 is free to try (no free credits are granted on startup). Paid Weekly (12 credits/week), Monthly (45 credits/month), and Quarterly (135 credits/quarter) subscriptions unlock all 15+ exam papers. Reading, Listening, Sprachbausteine, and Stories use 0 credits. A single Speaking Teil costs 1 credit, a Writing task costs 1 credit, and a Full 3-part Speaking Mock Exam costs 3 credits.

q3.question: Do unused credits roll over to the next month, and when are credits deducted?
q3.answer: Subscription credits are valid for your current billing cycle only and do NOT roll over to the next week, month, or quarter. However, any credits purchased via one-time Consumable Top-Up Packs (+5, +15, or +35 credits) never expire and are kept permanently in your account until used. Please note that credits are deducted immediately as soon as you start an exam session and cannot be refunded or restored if the app or phone closes by mistake or disconnects.

q4.question: How does Handwritten Photo Vision OCR work in Schreiben?
q4.answer: In the real exam, you write on a paper answer sheet (Antwortbogen S30). In Lingoberg, you can either type your email directly in the app or write it by hand on paper and upload 1–2 photos. Our Vision OCR transcribes your exact handwriting and grades it against official CEFR criteria (Task Fulfillment, Communicative Design, and Formal Accuracy).

q5.question: Is Lingoberg affiliated with telc gGmbH or the Goethe-Institut?
q5.answer: No. Lingoberg is an independent educational app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by telc gGmbH, the Goethe-Institut, or ÖSD. All AI scores and feedback are simulated practice estimates designed to help you prepare.
